text:
carla: Noticed 502 burst in eu-west during canary while nodes were draining. Looks tied to PV attach backlog, not app errors.
deploy-bot: Automated: promotion stalled. Will rollback in 5m unless manual pin applied. Reason: 502 during eviction.
dave: Confirmed pods stuck in Pending waiting for disk attach (~35s). infra scaling + drain overlap.
sre-oncall: We can suppress rollback with a manual pin; alternatively extend eviction timeout but pin is faster. Who can authorize?
carla: I'll run the pin. Planning: annotate HelmRelease, pause auto-rollback, open INFRA ticket to requeue attach, re-evaluate in 20-30m.
ops-eng: Please add an annotation with approver and reason so deploy-bot knows to hold.
carla: Ran: kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-cache-v2 release.redwood/pinned-by=carla release.redwood/pin-reason="pv-attach-during-drain" --overwrite && deployctl rollout patch srvc-cache-v2 --pause-auto-rollback=true
deploy-bot: Confirmed pin present. Automated rollback suppressed (TTL 45m). Manual unpin: kubectl annotate helmrelease srvc-cache-v2 release.redwood/pinned-by-
sre-oncall: Authorizing pin: sre-oncall. I'll monitor error rate and CPU/attach metrics.
dave: INFRA-2148 created: requeue PV attach, investigate attach queue saturation.
carla: Adding release-note: "temporary pin due to node-drain PV attach delay in eu-west; monitoring; rollback if persists beyond 30m."
sre-oncall: If metrics are green at +25m we can remove pin and let promotion finish. If not, rollback at +30m.
carla: Closing update for now. Will post final unpin or rollback result.
